prompts.text: Name a creature from myth or folklore.
prompts.flavor: Every map once had a margin where the monsters lived. Some of the margins are still there.
prompts.rules: Any monster or creature from the world's myths, legends and folklore, cryptids included. Creatures invented for books, films or games don't count.
